text: Standing in front of this glass-walled room, I feel curiosity stirring within me. The environment is clean, modern, and purposeful—a laboratory of ideas. As I cross the threshold and face the vibrant wall of "R+D" (Research and Development), there is a sense of anticipation. I recognize this is a space dedicated to innovation, bridging humanity and technology. Here, possibility seems to hover in the air, inviting contemplation about our collective future. The world feels both open-ended and demanding, as though it is urging me to ask, 'What shall we create next?'
